mechanismB_genuineCoverageGap.reasoning: mechanism B requires falling outside EVERY staged district polygon; that is false here -- a real staged polygon contains every one of the 13. What is actually true is narrower and different: each falls outside every polygon the PER-COUNTY HOIST includes as a candidate for that parcel's catalogued county. That is a candidate-set defect, not an absence, and writing absent-verified for these would be exactly the lie ENFORCEMENT.md and this dispatch warn against -- CTX-LEAVES2's own 100%-refused finding is the cautionary precedent.

discoveredMechanismD_crossJurisdictionBo.rootCauseLocation: src/jobs/parcel-school-district.mjs, HOIST_SCHOOL_DISTRICTS_SQL, final WHERE clause: `AND ST_Intersects(geom, county_geom)` (pre-fix)
discoveredMechanismD_crossJurisdictionBo.mechanism: every affected parcel's centroid sits just outside its own CATALOGUED county's tx_county_boundary polygon and just inside the TRUE neighboring county's polygon instead; tx_school_district and tx_county_boundary are independently digitized sources whose shared county-line edges do not align to the meter, so the district polygon and the catalogued county's polygon fail strict ST_Intersects by a small, real margin even though the parcel's true district is right there
discoveredMechanismD_crossJurisdictionBo.remainingNine: not individually meter-measured (time-bounded); each individually confirmed via the same statewide single-hit test above, and all 13 collectively confirmed via the full-population live dry-run in the close artifact
discoveredMechanismD_crossJurisdictionBo.whyInvisibleElsewhere: p2-juris-store.mjs HOIST_CITIES_SQL and parcel-overlay-districts.mjs's hoist share the identical bbox+ST_Intersects(county) pattern and are unmodified by this fix -- untested for this defect class, but no live evidence it manifests there, because city/overlay-district polygons are compact interior features that essentially never have an edge running along a county line the way a Texas ISD boundary routinely does (acquire-school-district.mjs's own module doc: ISDs span multiple counties 'more so than a city').

fixDesign.change: remove the `AND ST_Intersects(geom, county_geom)` clause from HOIST_SCHOOL_DISTRICTS_SQL; keep the bbox pre-filter (west/east/south/north_lng/lat comparisons against tx_county_boundary), matching the same bbox test the hoist already ran
